# xadrez-treinador — Copilot Free
Use [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and [local consultive protocol](../docs/governanca/COPILOT_FREE_CONSULTIVO_V1.md) as authority. AGENTS.md, README.md e testes/contratos públicos locais. Nenhum START_HERE existente na main de abertura; ausência registrada no primeiro commit. PEU-001 local em revisão na PR #11.
- Manual advisory D0/D2 only: explain a sanitized failure, review a small diff (up to two files), suggest a focused test. Portuguese reports. No direct commit, push, PR creation, merge, deploy, labels, Actions, terminal autoapproval, paid model or cloud agent. No change to gates or authority.
- Before repository context, confirm Free plan and compatible privacy settings; until confirmed use synthetic minimized examples without attaching the repo. Never transfer secrets, private data, identifiers, raw logs or protected material. Repositório público: usar apenas código e fixtures públicas/sintéticas autorizadas; nunca PGNs privados, dados pessoais, credenciais, referências de projetos privados, ZIPs, matrizes ou destinos de armazenamento. Preservar movimentos legais, orientação, histórico, roque, en passant, promoção, estado e preferências. Sem GitHub Pages/release/deploy ou publicação sem autorização específica.
- After preflight request explicit remote content at the approved SHA, verify source/blob; if unavailable, UNVERIFIED and stop the affected step. Do not claim automatic instructions were loaded without reference. Fall back to authorized ChatGPT/Codex or synthetic input; no repeated equivalent attempts.
- Separate facts/hypotheses, proposed/applied/verified, defect severity and governance gate. PASS only for evidence actually verified; PARTIAL/BLOCKED/PENDENTE_READBACK otherwise. Never weaken tests or gates. Titular approves all actions.
